example.en: This blanket feels soft against my skin.
example.zh: 這條毯子貼著皮膚很柔軟。

example.en: Please do not ignore the warning signs.
example.zh: 請不要忽略警告標誌。

example.en: I boiled an egg for breakfast.
example.zh: 我煮了一顆蛋當早餐。

example.en: Her belief in fairness guides her decisions.
example.zh: 她對公平的信念指引她做決定。

example.en: The instructor will demonstrate how to use the machine.
example.zh: 老師會示範如何使用這台機器。

example.en: Does anybody know where the keys are?
example.zh: 有人知道鑰匙在哪裡嗎？

example.en: The police are investigating a murder.
example.zh: 警方正在調查一宗謀殺案。

example.en: I brought a small gift for the host.
example.zh: 我帶了一份小禮物給主人。

example.en: People of different religions live in this neighborhood.
example.zh: 不同宗教信仰的人住在這個社區。

example.en: Let's review the key points before the test.
example.zh: 考試前我們來複習重點。

example.en: The editor suggested a clearer title.
example.zh: 編輯建議換一個更清楚的標題。

example.en: The workshop encourages staff to engage in discussion.
example.zh: 這場工作坊鼓勵員工參與討論。

example.en: Would you like milk in your coffee?
example.zh: 你的咖啡要加牛奶嗎？

example.en: Please sign the document at the bottom.
example.zh: 請在文件下方簽名。

example.en: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
example.zh: 路面濕滑時請減速。

example.en: Wait for the light before you cross the street.
example.zh: 等燈號變了再過馬路。

example.en: Friends can influence the choices we make.
example.zh: 朋友會影響我們做的選擇。

example.en: It was raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
example.zh: 雖然下雨，我們還是去散步了。

example.en: We cannot commit to a date until everyone replies.
example.zh: 等大家回覆後我們才能確定日期。

example.en: Floods threaten homes near the river.
example.zh: 洪水威脅河邊的住家。

example.en: The study included both male and female participants.
example.zh: 這項研究包含男性與女性參與者。

example.en: He spent much of his youth in the countryside.
example.zh: 他年輕時大多住在鄉下。

example.en: She gave us a wave from the balcony.
example.zh: 她在陽台上向我們揮手。

example.en: My little brother is afraid of the dark.
example.zh: 我的弟弟怕黑。

words.zh: 四分之一；一季；十五分鐘

example.en: Cut the sandwich into quarters.
example.zh: 把三明治切成四等分。

example.en: Her background in nursing helps her in this role.
example.zh: 她的護理背景對這份工作很有幫助。

example.en: These plants are native to Taiwan.
example.zh: 這些植物原生於臺灣。

example.en: The course covers a broad range of topics.
example.zh: 這門課涵蓋的主題很廣。

example.en: We had a wonderful evening with friends.
example.zh: 我們和朋友度過了一個愉快的夜晚。

example.en: He did not deny making the mistake.
example.zh: 他沒有否認犯了那個錯。

example.en: Apparently, the shop has moved to a new address.
example.zh: 聽說這家店搬到新地址了。

example.en: This jacket is slightly too big for me.
example.zh: 這件外套對我來說稍微大了一點。

example.en: What was her reaction to the news?
example.zh: 她聽到消息後有什麼反應？

example.en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
example.zh: 我一天刷兩次牙。

example.en: That meeting time does not suit me.
example.zh: 那個開會時間不適合我。

example.en: Try looking at the problem from her perspective.
example.zh: 試著從她的角度看這個問題。

example.en: Blow on the soup to cool it down.
example.zh: 吹一吹湯，讓它涼一點。

example.en: The road is closed during construction.
example.zh: 道路在施工期間封閉。

example.en: The puzzle tests memory and intelligence.
example.zh: 這個謎題考驗記憶力和智力。

example.en: The fire destroyed several houses.
example.zh: 那場火災燒毀了好幾棟房子。

example.en: I usually cook dinner after work.
example.zh: 我通常下班後煮晚餐。

example.en: The internet connection is slow today.
example.zh: 今天的網路連線很慢。

example.en: Be careful not to burn your hand on the pan.
example.zh: 小心別讓鍋子燙傷你的手。

example.en: There is a small stone in my shoe.
example.zh: 我的鞋子裡有一顆小石頭。

example.en: Our neighbor waters our plants when we travel.
example.zh: 我們旅行時鄰居會幫忙澆花。

example.en: She received a good grade on her essay.
example.zh: 她的作文拿到了好成績。

example.en: Read the whole sentence to understand the word in context.
example.zh: 讀完整句，才能從上下文理解這個字。

example.en: The committee will meet next Tuesday.
example.zh: 委員會將在下週二開會。

example.en: Hey, you left your bag on the chair!
example.zh: 嘿，你把包包忘在椅子上了！

example.en: I sent the message to the wrong person by mistake.
example.zh: 我不小心把訊息傳錯人了。

example.en: Send me the location of the restaurant.
example.zh: 把餐廳的位置傳給我。

example.en: Hang your wet clothes outside.
example.zh: 把濕衣服晾在外面。

example.en: Please keep quiet while the baby is sleeping.
example.zh: 寶寶睡覺時請保持安靜。

example.en: She wore a blue dress to the wedding.
example.zh: 她穿藍色洋裝參加婚禮。

example.en: I promise to call when I arrive.
example.zh: 我答應抵達後會打電話。

example.en: Are you aware of the change in plans?
example.zh: 你知道計畫有變嗎？

example.en: This button has a different function on each screen.
example.zh: 這個按鈕在不同畫面有不同功能。

example.en: The doctor checked for a broken bone.
example.zh: 醫師檢查是否有骨折。

example.en: Walking every day helps me stay active.
example.zh: 每天走路幫助我保持活力。

example.en: Could we extend the deadline by two days?
example.zh: 我們可以把截止日期延後兩天嗎？

example.en: Our chief concern is the safety of the workers.
example.zh: 我們最關心的是工人的安全。

example.en: Combine the flour and sugar in a bowl.
example.zh: 把麵粉和糖混合在碗裡。

example.en: This dish goes well with white wine.
example.zh: 這道菜很適合搭配白葡萄酒。

example.en: The temperature fell below ten degrees last night.
example.zh: 昨晚氣溫降到十度以下。

example.en: Let the bread cool before slicing it.
example.zh: 等麵包冷卻後再切片。

example.en: Each voter receives one ballot.
example.zh: 每位選民領取一張選票。

example.en: The bus stops right outside the hospital.
example.zh: 公車就停在醫院外面。

example.en: The long wait in the heat was hell.
example.zh: 在酷熱中漫長等待十分難熬。

example.en: It is dangerous to swim here after heavy rain.
example.zh: 大雨後在這裡游泳很危險。

example.en: Please remind me to bring an umbrella.
example.zh: 請提醒我帶雨傘。

example.en: The story raises a difficult moral question.
example.zh: 這個故事提出一個棘手的道德問題。

example.en: The team remained united despite the setback.
example.zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，團隊仍然團結一致。

example.en: Put each expense in the correct category.
example.zh: 把每筆支出歸入正確類別。

example.en: The apartment is relatively quiet at night.
example.zh: 這間公寓晚上比較安靜。

example.en: The team celebrated its first victory of the season.
example.zh: 球隊慶祝本季首勝。

example.en: She needs more time for her academic work.
example.zh: 她需要更多時間處理課業。

example.en: We booked our tickets on the internet.
example.zh: 我們在網路上訂了票。

example.en: A healthy breakfast helps me start the day.
example.zh: 健康的早餐幫助我展開一天。

example.en: The test result was negative.
example.zh: 檢驗結果是陰性。

example.en: We visited several historical sites during the trip.
example.zh: 旅途中我們參觀了幾處歷史古蹟。

example.en: Take this medicine after meals.
example.zh: 這個藥飯後服用。

example.en: We joined a walking tour of the old town.
example.zh: 我們參加了舊城區的步行導覽。

example.en: Our plans depend on the weather.
example.zh: 我們的計畫取決於天氣。

example.en: Grab your coat before we leave.
example.zh: 出門前趕快拿上你的外套。

example.en: Is there a direct flight to the island?
example.zh: 有直飛那座島的班機嗎？

example.en: The students returned to the classroom after lunch.
example.zh: 學生午餐後回到教室。

example.en: Contact the office if you need help.
example.zh: 需要幫忙時請聯絡辦公室。

example.en: The families are still seeking justice.
example.zh: 這些家庭仍在尋求公道。

example.en: This photograph was taken on our first trip together.
example.zh: 這張照片是我們第一次一起旅行時拍的。

example.en: Everyone is welcome to participate in the discussion.
example.zh: 歡迎大家參與討論。

example.en: I check my email daily.
example.zh: 我每天查看電子郵件。

example.en: We need a fair way to divide the work.
example.zh: 我們需要公平分配工作的方法。

example.en: I need a new pair of glasses.
example.zh: 我需要一副新眼鏡。

example.en: The village is famous for its tea.
example.zh: 這座村莊以茶聞名。

example.en: Gentle exercise can improve your sleep.
example.zh: 溫和的運動能改善睡眠。

example.en: My knee hurts when I climb stairs.
example.zh: 我爬樓梯時膝蓋會痛。

example.en: The flowers in the garden attract bees.
example.zh: 花園裡的花吸引蜜蜂。

words.zh: 膠帶；錄音帶；用膠帶黏貼

example.en: Use some tape to seal the box.
example.zh: 用膠帶把箱子封好。

example.en: We plan to hire two more assistants.
example.zh: 我們打算再僱用兩名助理。

example.en: Her voice sounded familiar.
example.zh: 她的聲音聽起來很熟悉。

example.en: Wear shoes that are appropriate for hiking.
example.zh: 穿適合健行的鞋子。

example.en: The storm disrupted the water supply.
example.zh: 暴風雨使供水中斷。

example.en: Make sure the battery is fully charged.
example.zh: 確認電池已充滿電。

example.en: The actor learned sign language for the role.
example.zh: 那位演員為了角色學習手語。

example.en: Please write your date of birth here.
example.zh: 請在這裡填寫出生日期。

example.en: We searched the house for the missing keys.
example.zh: 我們在屋裡尋找不見的鑰匙。

example.en: Can you help me tie this ribbon?
example.zh: 你可以幫我綁這條緞帶嗎？

example.en: Free elections are an important part of democracy.
example.zh: 自由選舉是民主制度的重要一環。

example.en: Heavy rain is expected in the eastern part of the country.
example.zh: 預計這個國家的東部將有大雨。

example.en: Our primary goal is to finish the repairs safely.
example.zh: 我們的主要目標是安全完成維修。

example.en: I left my umbrella here yesterday.
example.zh: 我昨天把雨傘忘在這裡。

example.en: Draw a circle around the correct answer.
example.zh: 把正確答案圈起來。

example.en: This device measures your heart rate.
example.zh: 這個裝置可以測量心率。

example.en: You have made good progress with your reading.
example.zh: 你的閱讀能力進步很多。

example.en: Your receipt is at the bottom of the bag.
example.zh: 你的收據在袋子底部。

example.en: We took a boat to a nearby island.
example.zh: 我們搭船到附近的一座島。

example.en: Where can I exchange money?
example.zh: 我可以在哪裡換錢？

example.en: Please clean the table after dinner.
example.zh: 晚餐後請把桌子擦乾淨。

example.en: She rents a small studio to record music.
example.zh: 她租了一間小型錄音室錄音。

example.en: The county operates a free shuttle bus.
example.zh: 這個縣提供免費接駁公車。

example.en: The last train leaves at eleven.
example.zh: 末班火車十一點開。

example.en: The lady at the front desk helped us check in.
example.zh: 櫃檯的女士幫我們辦理入住。

example.en: A colleague offered to cover my shift.
example.zh: 一位同事主動提出幫我代班。

example.en: Please submit your application by Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五以前送出申請。

example.en: Do not lean against the glass door.
example.zh: 不要靠在玻璃門上。

example.en: My neck feels stiff after sitting all day.
example.zh: 坐了一整天後，我的脖子很僵硬。

example.en: The leak caused damage to the ceiling.
example.zh: 漏水造成天花板損壞。

example.en: We are trying to use less plastic.
example.zh: 我們正在設法減少塑膠用量。

example.en: The shelf is too tall for me to reach.
example.zh: 架子太高，我搆不到。

example.en: Put the toast on a clean plate.
example.zh: 把吐司放在乾淨的盤子上。

example.en: I hate being late for appointments.
example.zh: 我討厭赴約遲到。

example.en: Leave now; otherwise, you will miss the bus.
example.zh: 現在就出門，否則會錯過公車。

example.en: The male bird has bright blue feathers.
example.zh: 這隻雄鳥有鮮藍色的羽毛。

example.en: The plant is still alive despite the dry soil.
example.zh: 雖然土壤乾燥，這株植物還活著。

example.en: The surprised expression on her face made us laugh.
example.zh: 她臉上驚訝的表情讓我們笑了。

example.en: They play football in the park on Sundays.
example.zh: 他們星期天在公園踢足球。

example.en: The theater opens thirty minutes before the show.
example.zh: 劇院在演出前三十分鐘開放入場。

example.en: I intend to finish the report tonight.
example.zh: 我打算今晚完成報告。

example.en: We had grilled chicken with rice.
example.zh: 我們吃了烤雞配飯。

example.en: Her brother serves in the army.
example.zh: 她哥哥在陸軍服役。

example.en: The organization helps victims of abuse.
example.zh: 這個組織協助受虐者。

example.en: Please shut the window before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請把窗戶關上。

example.en: We used a map to find the hiking trail.
example.zh: 我們用地圖找到登山步道。

example.en: Bring an extra shirt in case it rains.
example.zh: 多帶一件上衣，以防下雨。

example.en: The nearest gas station is a mile away.
example.zh: 最近的加油站在一英里外。

words.zh: 一段活動時間；會議；場次

example.en: The training session lasts two hours.
example.zh: 這場訓練課程持續兩小時。

example.en: We welcome suggestions from all members.
example.zh: 我們歡迎所有成員提供建議。

example.en: The firefighters brought everyone out of danger.
example.zh: 消防員讓所有人脫離險境。

example.en: Domestic flights leave from the smaller terminal.
example.zh: 國內班機從較小的航廈出發。

example.en: The earth in the garden is still wet.
example.zh: 花園裡的泥土還是濕的。

example.en: She enjoys reading literature from different countries.
example.zh: 她喜歡閱讀各國文學。

example.en: Heavy rain delayed the outdoor concert.
example.zh: 大雨讓戶外音樂會延後了。

example.en: He has a strong desire to travel.
example.zh: 他很渴望去旅行。

example.en: The doctor carried out a full assessment of her health.
example.zh: 醫師對她的健康做了全面評估。

example.en: A knee injury kept him from running.
example.zh: 膝蓋受傷讓他無法跑步。

example.en: Please respect other people's privacy.
example.zh: 請尊重別人的隱私。

example.en: We plan to paint the kitchen walls white.
example.zh: 我們打算把廚房牆壁漆成白色。

example.en: Snow is expected in the northern mountains.
example.zh: 預計北部山區會下雪。

example.en: She gave a small nod to show that she understood.
example.zh: 她輕輕點頭，表示她明白了。

example.en: The car uses less fuel on long trips.
example.zh: 這輛車長途行駛時比較省油。

example.en: A yellow leaf floated down from the tree.
example.zh: 一片黃葉從樹上飄落。

example.en: Leave your shoes here until they are dry.
example.zh: 把鞋子放在這裡直到晾乾。

example.en: Read the instructions before assembling the shelf.
example.zh: 組裝架子前請先閱讀說明。

example.en: The hotel has a small outdoor pool.
example.zh: 這間旅館有一座小型戶外游泳池。

example.en: We had to climb several steps to reach the entrance.
example.zh: 我們得爬幾階樓梯才能到入口。

example.en: These peaches are soft and sweet.
example.zh: 這些桃子又軟又甜。

example.en: Turn off the engine while you wait.
example.zh: 等候時請把引擎關掉。

example.en: Our office is on the fourth floor.
example.zh: 我們的辦公室在四樓。

example.en: Taste the soup before adding more salt.
example.zh: 加鹽前先嚐嚐湯。

example.en: The company plans to expand its delivery service.
example.zh: 公司計畫擴大外送服務。

example.en: The guide stressed the importance of drinking enough water.
example.zh: 嚮導強調補充足夠水分的重要性。

example.en: This table has a wooden top and metal legs.
example.zh: 這張桌子有木製桌面和金屬桌腳。

example.en: Nuts contain fat as well as protein.
example.zh: 堅果除了蛋白質，也含有脂肪。

example.en: Keep your ticket until you leave the station.
example.zh: 離開車站前請保留車票。

example.en: Update the software before using the new features.
example.zh: 使用新功能前請更新軟體。

example.en: The fog began to disappear as the sun rose.
example.zh: 隨著太陽升起，霧開始散去。

example.en: The hotel offers special rates for corporate guests.
example.zh: 這間飯店為企業客戶提供特別房價。

example.en: I heard a strange noise coming from the kitchen.
example.zh: 我聽見廚房傳來奇怪的聲音。

example.en: The cold wind made my lips dry.
example.zh: 冷風吹得我的嘴唇乾燥。

example.en: Urban parks give residents space to exercise.
example.zh: 都市公園提供居民運動的空間。

example.en: Regular breaks are good for your mental health.
example.zh: 規律休息有益心理健康。

example.en: More people are becoming increasingly interested in local food.
example.zh: 越來越多人對在地食物產生興趣。

example.en: Would you like to have lunch together tomorrow?
example.zh: 你明天要一起吃午餐嗎？

example.en: The museum offers educational activities for families.
example.zh: 博物館提供適合家庭參與的教育活動。

example.en: I left my phone somewhere in the house.
example.zh: 我把手機放在屋裡的某個地方了。

example.en: The farmer sells fresh vegetables at the market.
example.zh: 這位農夫在市場賣新鮮蔬菜。

example.en: I prefer tea without sugar.
example.zh: 我比較喜歡不加糖的茶。

example.en: The telescope lets us see several planets.
example.zh: 這具望遠鏡讓我們能看見幾顆行星。

words.zh: 最喜愛的；最喜愛的人或物

example.en: This is my favorite place to read.
example.zh: 這是我最喜歡閱讀的地方。

example.en: We spent the morning exploring the old streets.
example.zh: 我們花了一個上午探索老街。

example.en: You can obtain a copy of the form at the front desk.
example.zh: 你可以在櫃檯取得表格。

example.en: The two former enemies became close friends.
example.zh: 這兩個曾經的敵人成了好友。

example.en: The instructions are too complex for beginners.
example.zh: 這些說明對初學者來說太複雜。

example.en: Tall trees surround the small lake.
example.zh: 高大的樹木環繞著小湖。

example.en: The athlete trains for two hours every morning.
example.zh: 這位運動員每天早上訓練兩小時。

example.en: We invited our neighbors over for dinner.
example.zh: 我們邀請鄰居來家裡吃晚餐。

example.en: Could you repeat the address more slowly?
example.zh: 你可以把地址再慢慢說一次嗎？

example.en: Read the contract carefully before signing.
example.zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀合約。

example.en: Quiet walks by the sea are good for my soul.
example.zh: 在海邊安靜散步能讓我的心靈舒暢。

example.en: The report includes scientific evidence for its claims.
example.zh: 這份報告附有支持其主張的科學證據。

example.en: It is impossible to finish all this work in one hour.
example.zh: 這些工作不可能在一小時內全部完成。

example.en: The control panel shows the current temperature.
example.zh: 控制面板顯示目前溫度。

example.en: My mom taught me how to make soup.
example.zh: 我媽媽教我怎麼煮湯。

example.en: Which musical instrument would you like to learn?
example.zh: 你想學哪種樂器？

example.en: It is difficult to predict the exact path of a storm.
example.zh: 很難預測暴風雨的確切路徑。

example.en: The weather should improve by the weekend.
example.zh: 天氣到週末應該會好轉。

example.en: The presidential debate will be broadcast tonight.
example.zh: 總統候選人辯論會將在今晚播出。

example.en: I cannot attend because of a family commitment.
example.zh: 因為有已答應的家庭活動，我無法出席。

example.en: She needs emotional support during this difficult time.
example.zh: 她在這段艱難時期需要情感支持。

example.en: The constitution is the supreme law of the country.
example.zh: 憲法是這個國家的最高法律。

example.en: We saw a bear near the forest trail.
example.zh: 我們在森林步道附近看到一隻熊。

example.en: I keep my bus card in my coat pocket.
example.zh: 我把公車卡放在外套口袋裡。

example.en: Cut the cucumber into thin slices.
example.zh: 把小黃瓜切成薄片。

example.en: Check the water temperature before bathing the baby.
example.zh: 幫寶寶洗澡前先檢查水溫。

words.zh: 民意調查；投票；進行民調

example.en: The poll asked residents about public transport.
example.zh: 這份民調詢問居民對大眾運輸的看法。

example.en: The birthday cake was a lovely surprise.
example.zh: 那個生日蛋糕是個美好的驚喜。

example.en: The manager approved our proposal for flexible hours.
example.zh: 經理核准了我們彈性工時的提案。

example.en: Consider the possible consequences before you decide.
example.zh: 決定前先考慮可能的後果。

example.en: Take a deep breath and relax your shoulders.
example.zh: 深呼吸，放鬆肩膀。

example.en: Regular eye exams help protect your sight.
example.zh: 定期眼睛檢查有助於保護視力。

example.en: Check your account balance before making a payment.
example.zh: 付款前先查看帳戶餘額。

example.en: They decided to adopt a dog from a shelter.
example.zh: 他們決定從收容所認養一隻狗。

example.en: Only a small minority opposed the new schedule.
example.zh: 只有少數人反對新時程。

example.en: Go straight until you reach the library.
example.zh: 一直往前走，直到圖書館。

example.en: Connect the printer to your computer with this cable.
example.zh: 用這條線把印表機連到電腦。

example.en: Does this bag belong to you?
example.zh: 這個包包是你的嗎？

example.en: Volunteers delivered food aid to the village.
example.zh: 志工把糧食援助送到村裡。

example.en: I asked a friend for advice about the job offer.
example.zh: 我就這份工作邀約向朋友請教。

example.en: Is it okay if I open the window?
example.zh: 我可以開窗嗎？

example.en: We need to organize the files by date.
example.zh: 我們需要按日期整理檔案。

example.en: Please empty the trash before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請把垃圾倒掉。

example.en: The regional train stops at every small station.
example.zh: 這班區間列車在每個小站都停。

example.en: The trail leads to a waterfall.
example.zh: 這條步道通往瀑布。

example.en: I borrowed a novel from the library.
example.zh: 我從圖書館借了一本小說。

example.en: Enter the code sent to your phone.
example.zh: 輸入傳到手機的驗證碼。

example.en: Somehow, we managed to catch the last bus.
example.zh: 我們總算設法趕上末班公車。

example.en: The jury listened carefully to the evidence.
example.zh: 陪審團仔細聽取證據。

example.en: The clinic offers breast cancer screening.
example.zh: 這間診所提供乳癌篩檢。

example.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this message.
example.zh: 收到這則訊息後請回覆確認。

example.en: The theme of the exhibition is city life.
example.zh: 這場展覽的主題是城市生活。

example.en: The storm knocked down several trees.
example.zh: 暴風雨吹倒了好幾棵樹。

example.en: The union is negotiating better working conditions.
example.zh: 工會正在爭取更好的工作條件。

example.en: I keep a notebook on my desk.
example.zh: 我在書桌上放了一本筆記本。

example.en: We bought fresh fruit at the market.
example.zh: 我們在市場買了新鮮水果。

example.en: Train tickets are less expensive if you book early.
example.zh: 提早訂火車票比較便宜。

example.en: She tied a yellow ribbon around the box.
example.zh: 她在盒子上綁了黃色緞帶。

example.en: The report reaches a different conclusion.
example.zh: 這份報告得出不同的結論。

words.zh: 主要的；最佳的；全盛時期

example.en: Location is the prime reason we chose this hotel.
example.zh: 地點是我們選這間飯店的主要原因。

example.en: The tree casts a long shadow across the path.
example.zh: 那棵樹的長長影子投在小路上。

example.en: Many students struggle to balance work and study.
example.zh: 許多學生努力兼顧工作和課業。

example.en: We concluded the meeting with a short summary.
example.zh: 我們以簡短的摘要結束會議。

example.en: They learned to dance at a community center.
example.zh: 他們在社區中心學跳舞。

example.en: The analyst examined the sales figures.
example.zh: 分析師檢視了銷售數據。

example.en: New safety regulations apply to all factories.
example.zh: 新的安全規定適用於所有工廠。

example.en: I heard the phone ring in the next room.
example.zh: 我聽到隔壁房間的電話響了。

example.en: The project was largely funded by donations.
example.zh: 這項計畫的資金主要來自捐款。

example.en: My night shift starts at ten.
example.zh: 我的夜班十點開始。

example.en: The shop's revenue increased during the holidays.
example.zh: 這家店的營收在假期期間增加了。

example.en: We used the address to locate the building.
example.zh: 我們根據地址找到那棟大樓。

example.en: Mark the correct answer with a tick.
example.zh: 在正確答案旁打勾。

example.en: The building's appearance has changed after the renovation.
example.zh: 整修後，這棟建築的外觀改變了。

example.en: A package arrived for you this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上有你的包裹送到。

example.en: Please tell us if you have difficulty using the app.
example.zh: 使用應用程式有困難時請告訴我們。

example.en: The bridge is closed to cars during repairs.
example.zh: 這座橋維修期間禁止汽車通行。

example.en: Can you recommend a quiet restaurant nearby?
example.zh: 你可以推薦附近安靜的餐廳嗎？

example.en: There is no obvious solution to this problem.
example.zh: 這個問題沒有明顯的解決辦法。

example.en: The two plans are basically the same.
example.zh: 這兩個計畫基本上相同。

example.en: The solar panels generate electricity for the building.
example.zh: 太陽能板為這棟建築發電。

example.en: I do not live at that address anymore.
example.zh: 我已經不住在那個地址了。

example.en: I propose that we meet again next week.
example.zh: 我提議我們下週再開一次會。

example.en: Could you possibly give me a ride to the station?
example.zh: 可以麻煩你載我到車站嗎？

example.en: The report shows a trend toward smaller homes.
example.zh: 報告顯示住宅有變小的趨勢。

example.en: Visitors must sign in at the front desk.
example.zh: 訪客必須先在櫃檯登記。

example.en: We took out a loan to repair the house.
example.zh: 我們申請貸款來修繕房子。

example.en: The library is currently closed for repairs.
example.zh: 圖書館目前因維修而關閉。

example.en: These shoes are comfortable enough for a long walk.
example.zh: 這雙鞋很舒服，適合走長路。

example.en: The investor asked about the company's long-term plans.
example.zh: 投資人詢問公司的長期計畫。

example.en: The bakery made a small profit last month.
example.zh: 這家麵包店上個月有小幅獲利。

example.en: He was angry about the unexpected charge.
example.zh: 他對那筆意外收費很生氣。

words.zh: 工作團隊；機組人員；船員

example.en: The crew checked the aircraft before takeoff.
example.zh: 機組人員在起飛前檢查飛機。

example.en: An accident caused a long delay on the highway.
example.zh: 一起事故造成高速公路長時間延誤。

example.en: This meal includes soup and a drink.
example.zh: 這份餐點包含湯和飲料。

example.en: We left early to avoid heavy traffic.
example.zh: 我們提早出門以避開塞車。

example.en: Swimming helps strengthen your back muscles.
example.zh: 游泳有助於強化背部肌肉。

example.en: I had no notion of how much the repairs would cost.
example.zh: 我完全不知道維修要花多少錢。

example.en: The photo captures the excitement of the festival.
example.zh: 這張照片捕捉了節慶的熱鬧氣氛。

example.en: I prefer walking to taking the bus on sunny days.
example.zh: 晴天時，比起搭公車，我更喜歡走路。

example.en: He felt a sharp pain in his chest.
example.zh: 他覺得胸口一陣刺痛。

example.en: I truly appreciate your help.
example.zh: 我真心感謝你的幫忙。

example.en: The book has a thick cover.
example.zh: 這本書有厚厚的封面。

example.en: Do you accept cash only?
example.zh: 你們只收現金嗎？

example.en: The museum is free on the first Sunday of each month.
example.zh: 博物館每月第一個星期日免費入場。

example.en: We stopped to enjoy the beauty of the sunset.
example.zh: 我們停下來欣賞夕陽之美。

example.en: Keep this number handy in case of an emergency.
example.zh: 把這個號碼留在手邊，以備緊急時使用。

example.en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern.
example.zh: 每個手工碗都有獨特的花紋。

example.en: This report is for internal use only.
example.zh: 這份報告僅供內部使用。

example.en: The festival celebrates the traditions of different ethnic groups.
example.zh: 這個節慶展現不同族群的傳統。

example.en: Click the link in the confirmation email.
example.zh: 點選確認信中的連結。

example.en: Regular exercise helps me manage stress.
example.zh: 規律運動幫助我調適壓力。

issues.reason: 英式拼字，與organization為同一詞，單獨計數會重複。
issues.suggestion: 保留organization主詞條，將organisation列為拼字變體。
